summary: Iran holds mass funerals for 350 unidentified battle casualties attended by its president and IRGC commander, while multiple explosions hit the 15 Khordad air defense base in Isfahan and an "enemy" strike targets the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base at Sirik. CENTCOM intercepts two Iranian attack drones aimed at Bahrain, denying Tehran's claim of hitting a U.S. radar. Meanwhile, Mossad chief Roman Gofman meets CIA Director Ratcliffe in Washington as Netanyahu presses Trump to resume war on Iran despite Gulf opposition.
key_points: Iran conducts mass funerals for 350 unidentified battle casualties with President and IRGC Commander Vahidi attending the main ceremony for 110 at Tehran University. (Source: @yediotnews25/137780)

IAEA confidential report expresses growing concern over Iran's underground uranium enrichment facility in Isfahan, blocked from inspectors since June 2025, citing "serious concern about nuclear weapons proliferation." (Source: @yediotnews25/137790)

Three explosions reported at the 15 Khordad military base in Isfahan, the latest in the barracks' warehouse area, indicating sustained attacks on Iranian air defense infrastructure. (Source: @shin_persian/12327, @shin_persian/12329)

CENTCOM shoots down two Iranian attack drones heading toward Bahrain, denying IRGC claim of striking a U.S. early-warning radar; no injuries or damage reported. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9936, @shin_persian/12323)

IRNA reports an "enemy" military strike on Sirik in Hormozgan province, home to the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base on the Strait of Hormuz; no claim of responsibility. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9922)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminate over 10 terrorists in Gaza including October 7 infiltrators and destroy a weapons workshop, while arresting 55+ wanted Palestinians in the West Bank and four ISIS-affiliated suspects in Jenin. (Source: @N12chat/234892, @yediotnews25/137787, @manniefabian/59515)

Mossad chief Roman Gofman meets CIA Director John Ratcliffe in Washington, expected to meet Steve Witkoff and Marco Rubio, as Netanyahu urges Trump to resume war on Iran despite Gulf state opposition. (Source: @N12chat/234891, @Faytuks_Network/9934)
Turkey and Qatar sign a mutual defense agreement; Erdogan pledges continued coordination with Qatar to prevent regional war escalation. (Source: @N12chat/234897)

points: Mass funerals held nationwide for 350 unidentified "battle casualties"; the main ceremony at Tehran University for 110 was attended by Iran's president and IRGC Commander General Vahidi, signaling significant undisclosed losses. (Source: @yediotnews25/137780)

IAEA confidential report cites growing concern over an underground uranium enrichment facility in Isfahan that Iran has blocked inspectors from visiting since its June 2025 declaration; the agency warns of "serious concern about nuclear weapons proliferation" due to lack of access and inventory data. (Source: @yediotnews25/137790)

Three separate explosions rock the 15 Khordad military base in Isfahan Province: smoke visible after an initial blast, followed by a third explosion precisely in the barracks' warehouse area at 1324Z, indicating sustained targeting of a key air defense installation. (Source: @shin_persian/12327, @shin_persian/12329)

IRGC claims to have struck a U.S. early-warning radar in Bahrain, but CENTCOM confirms shooting down both attack drones with no injuries or damage; the interception underscores active Iranian drone operations against U.S. assets in the Gulf. (Source: @shin_persian/12323, @Faytuks_Network/9936, @N12chat/234886)

Iran's state news agency IRNA reports an "enemy" military strike on Sirik in Hormozgan province on the Strait of Hormuz, home to the IRGC's Shahid Rahbari naval base; no party has claimed responsibility for the attack on this strategic naval facility. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9922)

U.S. 5th Fleet Commander Vice Adm. Curt Renshaw completes visit to Israel, meeting Israeli Navy Chief Vice Adm. Eyal Harel to discuss naval operations across multiple arenas, maritime security, fleet coordination, and technological knowledge-sharing; the 5th Fleet is headquartered in Bahrain and engaged in low-level fighting against Iran in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz amid a U.S. naval blockade of Iranian ports. (Source: @yediotnews25/137786, @manniefabian/59514)

Mossad chief Roman Gofman visits Washington for talks on Iran, meeting CIA Director John Ratcliffe and expected to meet National Security Advisor Marco Rubio and Special Envoy Steve Witkoff; the visit comes as Netanyahu presses Trump to resume war on Iran despite opposition from Gulf states. (Source: @N12chat/234891, @Faytuks_Network/9934)

IDF and Shin Bet eliminate more than 10 terrorists in Gaza over the past week, including operatives who infiltrated Israel on October 7, and destroy a weapons manufacturing workshop; simultaneously, a Red Alert sounds in the Gaza Envelope at Nachal Oz (15-second warning) and airstrikes hit the Zeitoun neighborhood in Gaza City, wounding two. (Source: @N12chat/234892, @tzevaadom_en/68583, @yediotnews25/137792)

West Bank counter-terrorism operations yield over 55 wanted arrests across Judea and Samaria, including Hamas and Palestinian Islamic Jihad activists planning attacks; weapons are confiscated and inciting monuments linked to terror founders are demolished in the Etzion Brigade sector. (Source: @yediotnews25/137787)

Paratroopers Brigade detains four wanted Palestinian terror suspects in the Jenin area during an overnight raid based on Shin Bet intelligence; two are affiliated with the Islamic State and all four planned attacks on Israeli civilians and security forces. (Source: @manniefabian/59515, @N12chat/234887)

Israeli warplanes operate over southern Lebanon; forces deploy smoke bombs at the outskirts of Zoutar al-Sharqiya and conduct artillery shelling on the same town; a Hermes 450 drone withdraws from Beirut's southern suburbs toward the south. sections.threat_assessment: Iran is absorbing significant undisclosed military losses while its nuclear program advances under reduced IAEA oversight. Simultaneous explosions at the 15 Khordad air defense base and a strike on the Shahid Rahbari naval base suggest a coordinated campaign degrading Iranian strategic defenses. Iranian drone attacks on Bahrain demonstrate willingness to target U.S. allies, while CENTCOM's effective interception indicates robust defensive posture. Netanyahu's push for renewed war via Mossad diplomacy in Washington faces Gulf resistance, creating a volatile decision window for the Trump administration. The multi-front Israeli operations in Gaza, West Bank, and Lebanon continue to degrade militant capabilities but risk escalation.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are actively lobbying for restraint, with Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, UAE, and Bahrain reportedly urging a "more civil" approach to Iran. Turkey and Qatar formalize a mutual defense pact explicitly aimed at preventing regional war escalation. Saudi civil defense alerts in Jazan reflect concern over spillover from Yemen or Red Sea tensions. The U.S. 5th Fleet's ongoing low-level combat against Iran in the Gulf and Strait of Hormuz, coupled with the naval blockade of Iranian ports, signals sustained American military pressure. Diplomatic channels remain active with Mossad-CIA talks and Framework negotiations in Iraq.
sections.intelligence_notes: The mass funerals for 350 unidentified casualties suggest Iran is concealing the true scale of recent combat losses, possibly from Israeli or U.S. strikes not publicly acknowledged. The 15 Khordad base explosions align with patterns of targeted sabotage against Iranian air defense systems. The Sirik strike on the IRGC naval base indicates vulnerability of Iranian maritime assets in the Strait of Hormuz. IAEA's loss of access to the Isfahan enrichment facility since June 2025 creates a critical intelligence gap on Iran's breakout timeline. The Jenin arrests of ISIS-affiliated operatives reveal growing Islamic State presence in the West Bank. Hermes 450 drone withdrawal from Beirut suggests Israeli surveillance adjustments in Lebanon.
